card.name: Environmental regulation and countryside terms
card.fires_on: Capitalised words inside environmental policy and countryside names, such as Best Available Techniques, Integrated Prevention, Environment Agency and Sites of Special Scientific Interest. Mostly the middle or next word of a multi-word official name.
